title: Hourly to Annual Salary: How Tesla Salary Sacrifice Affects Your Pay
description: Convert your hourly rate to annual salary with our guide. Includes Tesla salary sacrifice, tax, super, and fortnightly pay. Use the timesheet for accurate estimates.
salarySummary: Based on a 38-hour week, your annual gross pay is your hourly rate multiplied by 38 then by 52, before tax and super.

faqs.q: How do I convert my hourly wage to an annual salary?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work each week, then by 52. For a standard full-time role of 38 hours per week, the formula is hourly × 38 × 52. This gives your gross annual pay before tax, super, and any deductions.

faqs.q: What is casual loading and how does it affect my annual pay?
faqs.a: Casual loading is an extra 25% paid on top of the base hourly rate to compensate for lack of paid leave. For example, the National Minimum Wage of $26.44 per hour becomes $33.05 per hour with loading. Your annual gross pay increases accordingly, and super is calculated on the loaded amount.

faqs.q: Can Tesla salary sacrifice reduce my taxable income?
faqs.a: Yes, salary sacrificing a Tesla through a novated lease reduces your pre-tax salary, lowering your income tax. However, super guarantee is still calculated on your ordinary earnings before the sacrifice, so your super contributions remain unchanged. The [timesheet](/topics/super-and-packaging) does not account for salary sacrifice, so you may need to adjust your taxable income manually.

bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding the Hourly to Annual Conversion

Converting your hourly rate to an annual salary is straightforward: multiply your hourly wage by the number of hours you work each week, then by 52. For a standard full-time role, we assume a 38-hour week, as set by the Fair Work Commission. This gives your gross annual pay before tax, super, and any deductions.

For example, the National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour. Multiplying by 38 hours gives $1,004.90 per week, and by 52 weeks gives $52,254.80 per year. This figure is the starting point for understanding your total remuneration.

### The Role of Award Rates and Casual Loading

The National Minimum Wage is the legal floor, but many employees are covered by award rates that may be higher. Awards set minimum pay for specific industries and roles. Additionally, casual employees receive a 25% loading on top of their base rate to compensate for not receiving paid leave. For the minimum wage, this loading brings the casual rate to $33.05 per hour.

When calculating annual pay for a casual worker, use the loaded rate. For instance, $33.05 per hour × 38 hours × 52 weeks = $65,318.80 per year. Superannuation is paid on top of this total ordinary earnings at 12% (up to the $270,830 maximum contribution base).

### Fortnightly Pay and Budgeting

Many Australians are paid fortnightly. To find your fortnightly gross pay, simply double your weekly pay. Using the full-time minimum wage example, $1,004.90 per week becomes $2,009.80 per fortnight. This can help with budgeting and comparing job offers.

### Tax and Medicare

Your annual gross pay is not what you take home. The Australian Taxation Office applies a progressive tax scale for 2026–27: nil up to $18,200, then 15% from $18,201 to $45,000, 30% from $45,001 to $135,000, 37% to $190,000, and 45% above $190,001. The Medicare levy is generally 2% of your taxable income. Note that the 2026–27 Medicare levy surcharge thresholds for single individuals are based on 2025–26 figures because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. Salary sacrifice arrangements, such as a [Tesla salary sacrifice](/topics/super-and-packaging), reduce your taxable income, lowering your tax liability. However, the [timesheet](/topics/super-and-packaging) does not account for salary sacrifice, so you may need to adjust your taxable income manually.

### Average Earnings Comparisons

The Australian Bureau of Statistics' Average Weekly Earnings for May 2026 shows full-time adult ordinary time earnings of $2,083.70 per week. All employees total earnings average $1,579.20 per week, which includes part-time workers. These are averages, not medians for specific jobs. Use the [average pay](/topics/average-pay) page for more context.

### Using the Timesheet

The [timesheet](/) on our home page lets you enter your base hourly rate and optionally add 25% casual loading. It calculates your annual, fortnightly, and weekly gross pay, plus estimated tax and super. Remember, it assumes a 38-hour week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. For a Tesla salary sacrifice, you would need to manually reduce your taxable income in your own calculations.

### Key Takeaways

- Annual gross = hourly × hours per week × 52 (assume 38 hours for full-time).
- Fortnightly pay = weekly × 2.
- Casual loading adds 25% to the base rate.
- Super is 12% on top of ordinary earnings, up to the contribution base.
- Tax and Medicare are estimated using the 2026–27 resident tax scale with the full tax-free threshold.
- Salary sacrifice, such as a Tesla salary sacrifice, lowers taxable income but does not affect super guarantee.

Always check your award or enterprise agreement for your specific pay conditions. The Fair Work Ombudsman provides guidance on minimum rates and classifications.

### Disclaimer

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.
